<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Diversity Workshop — پخش تعاملی</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Vazirmatn:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
--violet:#8b5cf6;
--violet-2:#c084fc;
--bg:#050307;
--text:#e9e2f5;
--text-dim:#9184ac;
--line:rgba(196,132,252,0.18);
--mono:'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
--sans:'Vazirmatn', sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;height:100%;background:var(--bg);overflow:hidden;}
body{
font-family:var(--sans); color:var(--text);
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:100vh;
background:
radial-gradient(1000px 600px at 15% 10%, rgba(139,92,246,0.16), transparent 60%),
radial-gradient(900px 700px at 90% 90%, rgba(192,132,252,0.10), transparent 60%),
var(--bg);
}

.player{
position:relative; width:min(96vw, 1400px); aspect-ratio:16/9;
background:#000; border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden;
border:1px solid var(--line);
box-shadow:0 30px 90px -20px rgba(139,92,246,0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
}

.slides{ position:absolute; inset:0; }
.slide{
position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; transform:scale(1.02);
transition:opacity .65s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.slide.active{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1); z-index:2; pointer-events:auto; }

.bg-img{
position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:contain; background:#000;
transition:transform 6s linear; transform:scale(1);
}
.slide.active .bg-img{ transform:scale(1.045); }

.float-el{
position:absolute; cursor:grab; touch-action:none;
filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.45));
opacity:0; transform-origin:50% 50%;
animation:none;
}
.float-el img{ width:100%; height:100%; display:block; object-fit:cover; user-select:none; -webkit-user-drag:none; pointer-events:none; }
.float-el.is-circle img{ border-radius:50%; }
.float-el.is-circle{ border-radius:50%; }
.float-el.grabbing{ cursor:grabbing; filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 40px rgba(139,92,246,0.5)); }

.slide.active .float-el{
animation: popIn .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1.4,.4,1) forwards, bob 5.5s ease-in-out 0.7s infinite;
}
@keyframes popIn{
0%{ opacity:0; transform:scale(0.55) rotate(-14deg); }
70%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1.06) rotate(3deg); }
100%{ opacity:1; transform:scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
}
@keyframes bob{
0%,100%{ margin-top:0px; }
50%{ margin-top:-9px; }
}
.float-el.dragging{ animation:none !important; transition:none !important; }
.float-el .hint-ring{
position:absolute; inset:-8px; border-radius:inherit; border:1.5px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.55);
opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s ease; pointer-events:none;
}
.float-el:hover .hint-ring{ opacity:0.85; }

/* ambient decorative blobs for slides without extracted photos */
.ambient{ position:absolute; inset:0; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; z-index:1; }
.blob{
position:absolute; border-radius:50%; filter:blur(2px);
opacity:0; mix-blend-mode:screen;
}
.slide.active .blob{ animation: blobIn .9s ease forwards, drift 9s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes blobIn{ from{opacity:0; transform:scale(0.6);} to{opacity:0.55; transform:scale(1);} }
@keyframes drift{
0%,100%{ transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); }
50%{ transform:translate(14px,-16px) scale(1.06); }
}

.chrome-fade-top, .chrome-fade-bottom{
position:absolute; left:0; right:0; height:110px; z-index:8; pointer-events:none;
opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s ease;
}
.chrome-fade-top{ top:0; background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.65), transparent); }
.chrome-fade-bottom{ bottom:0; background:linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.75), transparent); }
.player:hover .chrome-fade-top, .player:hover .chrome-fade-bottom, .player.paused .chrome-fade-top, .player.paused .chrome-fade-bottom{ opacity:1; }

.top-bar{
position:absolute; top:14px; inset-inline:18px; z-index:9;
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim);
opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s ease;
}
.player:hover .top-bar, .player.paused .top-bar{ opacity:1; }
.top-bar .rec{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; color:var(--violet-2); }
.top-bar .rec .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--violet-2); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--violet-2); animation:blink 1.6s infinite;}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:0.25;}}
.touch-tag{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; color:var(--text-dim); }
.touch-tag svg{ width:13px; height:13px; fill:var(--violet-2); }

.segments{ position:absolute; top:36px; inset-inline:16px; z-index:9; display:flex; gap:5px; opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s ease; }
.player:hover .segments, .player.paused .segments{ opacity:1; }
.seg{ flex:1; height:3px; border-radius:3px; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16); overflow:hidden; cursor:pointer; }
.seg-fill{ height:100%; width:0%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--violet), var(--violet-2)); }
.seg.done .seg-fill{ width:100%; }

.controls{
position:absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0; z-index:9;
display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; padding:14px 18px 16px;
opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s ease;
}
.player:hover .controls, .player.paused .controls{ opacity:1; }
.ctl-btn{
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color:var(--text);
width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, border-color .15s; flex:none;
}
.ctl-btn:hover{ background:rgba(139,92,246,0.25); border-color:var(--violet-2); }
.ctl-btn svg{ width:16px; height:16px; fill:currentColor; }
.ctl-play{ width:44px; height:44px; background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), #6d28d9); border:none; }
.ctl-play:hover{ background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet-2), var(--violet)); }
.ctl-play svg{ width:18px; height:18px; }
.counter{ font-family:var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:var(--text-dim); min-width:56px; text-align:center; }
.spacer{flex:1;}
.speed-select{
background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14); color:var(--text);
font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 10px; cursor:pointer; outline:none;
}
.speed-select option{ background:#150c24; color:var(--text); }

.tap-zone{ position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; width:22%; z-index:3; cursor:pointer; }
.tap-left{ left:0; } .tap-right{ right:0; }

.veil{
position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:20; background:#050307;
display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:opacity .5s ease;
}
.veil.hide{ opacity:0; pointer-events:none; }
.veil-inner{ text-align:center; font-family:var(--mono); color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px; }
.veil-mark{
width:52px; height:52px; border-radius:14px; margin:0 auto 14px;
background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), var(--violet-2)); box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(139,92,246,0.5);
}

.toast{
position:absolute; top:60px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px);
background:rgba(20,10,30,0.85); border:1px solid var(--line); backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
color:var(--text); font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:8px 16px; border-radius:999px;
z-index:15; opacity:0; transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease; pointer-events:none; white-space:nowrap;
}
.toast.show{ opacity:1; transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }

.hint{
position:fixed; bottom:18px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%);
font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim); display:flex; gap:16px;
}
.hint kbd{ background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:5px; padding:2px 6px; font-family:var(--mono); color:var(--text); }
@media (max-width:700px){ .hint{display:none;} }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="player" id="player">
<div class="veil" id="veil">
<div class="veil-inner"><div class="veil-mark"></div>در حال آماده‌سازی پخش‌کننده…</div>
</div>

<div class="slides" id="slides"></div>

<div class="tap-zone tap-left" id="tapLeft"></div>
<div class="tap-zone tap-right" id="tapRight"></div>

<div class="chrome-fade-top"></div>
<div class="chrome-fade-bottom"></div>

<div class="top-bar">
<div class="rec"><span class="dot"></span> AUTO-PLAY</div>
<div class="touch-tag">
<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 11.24V7.5a2.5 2.5 0 015 0v3.74l1.1-.31a3 3 0 013.9 2.87V16a6 6 0 01-6 6h-1.5a6 6 0 01-5.1-2.83l-2.24-3.6a1.5 1.5 0 012.4-1.8l1.44 1.53V11.24a1.5 1.5 0 013 0z"/></svg>
عناصر با نور، قابل چرخش‌اند
</div>
</div>

<div class="segments" id="segments"></div>

<div class="controls">
<button class="ctl-btn" id="prevBtn" title="اسلاید قبل"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M15.5 5L8.5 12l7 7"/></svg></button>
<button class="ctl-btn ctl-play" id="playBtn" title="پخش / توقف"><svg id="playIcon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg></button>
<button class="ctl-btn" id="nextBtn" title="اسلاید بعد"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M8.5 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
<div class="counter" id="counter">1 / N</div>
<div class="spacer"></div>
<select class="speed-select" id="speedSelect" title="مدت هر اسلاید">
<option value="3000">۳ ثانیه</option>
<option value="4500" selected>۴.۵ ثانیه</option>
<option value="6000">۶ ثانیه</option>
<option value="9000">۹ ثانیه</option>
</select>
<button class="ctl-btn" id="fsBtn" title="تمام‌صفحه"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 9V4h5M20 9V4h-5M4 15v5h5M20 15v5h-5"/></svg></button>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast">می‌تونی این عکس رو بکشی و بچرخونی ✋</div>
</div>

<div class="hint">
<span><kbd>Space</kbd> پخش/توقف</span>
<span><kbd>&#8592;</kbd> <kbd>&#8594;</kbd> جابجایی</span>
<span><kbd>F</kbd> تمام‌صفحه</span>
<span>روی عکس‌ها بکش تا بچرخن 🔄</span>
</div>

<script>
const SLIDE_DATA = [{"bg": "data:image/jpeg;base64,
// ... عکس‌ها و داده‌های اسلایدهای قبلی شما ...
  {
    bg: "data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRg...", // عکس انتهای فایل شما
    elements: []
  }
]; // <--- آرایه عکس‌ها در اینجا بسته می‌شود

// ==========================================
// کدهای زیر را دقیقاً از اینجا به بعد چسبانده و اضافه کن:
// ==========================================

let currentIndex = 0;
let isPlaying = true;
let slideDuration = 4500;
let autoTimer = null;

// ... ادامه کدهایی که بالا فرستاده شد ...

initPlayer();
</script>
</body>
</html>
